identity.title: The Art of Pokémon the Movie 3: Spell of the Unown

leadText:
The Art of Pokémon the Movie 3: Spell of the Unown is an artbook first published by Shogakukan in Japan and then released by VIZ Media in English. It is based on the film of the same name and the Pikachu short Pikachu & Pichu.

The Art of Pokémon the Movie 3: Spell of the Unown consists of a narrated written adaptation of the film accompanied by full-color screen captures from the movie.
